posts.title: Pinned: what TifoMaker is
posts.text:
تيفو ناديك، بملعبه الحقيقي، كرسي كرسي.
تختار النادي، ترسم، وتشوفه يرتفع بالمدرج بالـ3D قبل ما تطبع ولا كرت.
مجاني، وأحلى تجربة على الكمبيوتر.
posts.gloss: Your club's tifo, in its real ground, seat by seat. Pick the club, draw, and watch it go up in the stand in 3D before you print a single card. Free, and best on a computer. (Reply: Try it, link.)

asset.file: marketing/video/x-promo/tifomaker-x-promo-1080p-clean.mp4

posts.why: The pinned post is what every new visitor reads first, so it says the one thing in plain Gulf Arabic. It says 'best on a computer' because designing needs a desktop; phones open the 3D viewer. The link goes in the first reply because posts with links in the main text are reported to get less reach on X.
posts.measure: Profile visits and link clicks over the week. Pin it and leave it.

media.caption: The 35-second promo, attached to the pinned post

posts.title: English intro for Premier League and LaLiga fans
posts.text:
Your club's tifo, in its real ground, one seat at a time.

147 real stadiums. Anfield, the Bernabéu, Kingdom Arena. Draw it, then watch it go up on match night in 3D.

Free, in your browser.

asset.file: marketing/social/media-kit/img/liverpool.jpg, real-madrid.jpg, ittihad.jpg, hero.jpg

posts.why: About a third of visits are in English. Naming the grounds people know does the selling without adjectives.
posts.measure: Link clicks from the reply, bookmarks.

posts.format: Text post with one image of the Ettifaq ground
posts.title: Matchday 13: you write the Ettifaq tifo
posts.text:
السبت الاتفاق يستقبل الهلال.

لو جمهور الاتفاق بيرفع تيفو… وش تكتبون فيه؟

أحسن رد نرسمه على مدرج ملعب الاتفاق الحقيقي، وننزله الجمعة.
posts.gloss: Saturday Ettifaq host Al-Hilal. If the Ettifaq fans were raising a tifo, what would you write on it? We draw the best reply on the real Ettifaq stand and post it Friday.

asset.file: Screenshot of Ettifaq's ground in the Stadium view, empty stand

posts.why: Replies are the strongest signal on X. This gives fans a job they enjoy, and the winner has a reason to share Friday's post. Rotate which club gets it each round so the account stays every club's.
posts.measure: Number of replies, and how many are real ideas rather than one-word answers.
posts.depends: Ettifaq v Al-Hilal is listed for Sat 28 Nov in third-party fixture lists. Check the SPL site before posting.

"[نص الرد]"

posts.title: Every Roshn League ground in its real blocks
posts.text:
ملاعب دوري روشن صارت مرسومة ببلوكاتها الحقيقية.

الدرج بمكانه، الممرات، فتحات المداخل، وأسماء البلوكات نفس اللي على تذكرتك.

يعني إذا قلت للقروب "التيفو من C3 إلى C7"، تشوف بالضبط وين بيطلع.
posts.gloss: The Roshn League grounds are now drawn in their real blocks: the stairs where they are, the walkways, the tunnels, and block names as printed on your ticket. So if you tell the group 'the tifo runs from C3 to C7', you see exactly where it goes up.

asset.file: Screenshot of a ground from above with its block names (scripts/block-plan.mts draws this)

posts.why: An announcement written as what it lets a fan do, with a real block name, reads like a fan talking. 'We are proud to announce' would read like a company.
posts.measure: Bookmarks and replies asking for a ground that isn't there yet (that list is the build queue).

decisions.q: One language or two, and one account or two?
decisions.rec: One account on each platform, and every post in one language, never both stacked in the same post. TikTok: Arabic only (English hashtags like #tifo at the end are fine). X: mostly Arabic, with separate English posts for Premier League, LaLiga and big announcements, not a translation of every post. YouTube: make each video in Arabic, then add an English title and description in YouTube's translation settings so each viewer sees their own language. Arabic posts link to tifomaker.org/ar/, English posts to tifomaker.org/, with a different link in each bio. Reserve @tifomaker_en on all three platforms and leave it empty.
decisions.why: Two accounts would split a small following and double the work for one person. Two languages in one post wastes the first second on TikTok and makes X posts harder to read. 70% of the TikTok audience is in Saudi Arabia, and video 1 lost most viewers in its first second partly because it was in English. Sending Arabic speakers to the Arabic site saves them hunting for the language switch. Start the English account only if, for a couple of months, English posts on X match the Arabic ones on engagement, or English-speaking visitors are more than about a third of social traffic to the site. Compare the two every Monday.
decisions.final: Agreed. One account per platform, one language per post, Arabic posts to /ar/.

decisions.q: Who is the face and voice of the account?
decisions.rec: Start with your voice over screen recordings, no face. Do one founder video (tt-06) and see how it lands.
decisions.why: A real person's voice is the clearest sign this isn't AI content, and a voice is easier to keep up every week than filming yourself.
decisions.final: ElevenLabs, one male Saudi or Gulf voice from its Voice Library, used in every video that needs a voice, on the eleven_v3 model. Every line is listened to before approval. Videos without a voice-over use on-screen text and a sound.

decisions.q: Can we use club crests and fan groups' photos?
decisions.rec: No official crests in our own posts: club colours and words only. Fan designs made in the app are fine. Always credit fan groups by handle, and ask before reusing their photos or videos.
decisions.why: Crests are trademarks. The groups are the people we most want on our side.
decisions.final: Changed. Lead with real designs fans have already made in the TifoMaker community, credited to them, after asking each designer. Crests inside a fan's own tifo are fine; that is what a tifo is. Our own designs are built properly around a club's nickname, chant or symbol, never flat colour blocks. Club crests never go on TifoMaker's own branding, and every bio says it is a fan-made tool, not linked to any club.

decisions.rec: Yes, the basic tier, for one quarter, then judge it on reach.
decisions.why: Several 2026 analyses say paid accounts get noticeably more reach, though nobody has measured it independently. It also adds the badge, edits and longer videos.
decisions.final: Agreed, starting a week or two after posting begins.

decisions.rec: X: 1–2 posts a day plus 15 minutes of replies. TikTok: 4 a week. YouTube: 3 Shorts a week and 1 long video every 2 weeks.
decisions.why: That's what one person can keep up without the quality dropping. Consistency matters more than volume.
decisions.final: One post a day on each platform once the video pipeline exists. Until then: X daily, TikTok and YouTube Shorts 3–4 a week, so no video goes out below the new standard.

decisions.q: How often do we mention Pro?
decisions.rec: At most 1 post in 8, and none on TikTok in the first month.
decisions.why: People follow for tifos. With 1 sale from 496 accounts, more sign-ups will help more than more sales pitches right now.
decisions.final: Agreed. At most 1 post in 8 mentions Pro, none on TikTok in the first month.

decisions.q: Prizes for the Asian Cup tifo contest?
decisions.rec: A year of Pro for each of the top 3, plus being shown on all three accounts on opening day.
decisions.why: It costs nothing to give and fans want it. Free entry, no purchase needed. Check whether a Saudi commerce licence is needed for a prize contest before announcing.
decisions.final: Changed. No formal contest. Fans who post an Al-Akhdar tifo get featured on all three accounts, and each featured designer gets 1 month of Pro. Nothing to fail if few join, and no prize licence question.

decisions.q: Build King Fahd Sports City before 7 January?
decisions.why: It hosts the Asian Cup opener and final. Without it, the biggest moment of the winter has no ground to design in.
decisions.final: Agreed. King Fahd Sports City built by 20 December.

decisions.rec: Nothing until a post beats our own average without help. Then SAR 50–100 of TikTok Promote behind that one post.
decisions.why: Paying to push a post that people don't watch only buys bad numbers.
decisions.final: Agreed. No ads until a post beats our own average without help.

decisions.rec: You post them yourself, in each app, after approving them here. TikTok sounds must be added in the app. X posts can be scheduled in X's own scheduler.
decisions.why: I can't post to X, TikTok or YouTube from here, so nothing goes out without you. Approvals on this page are the go-ahead I read back.
decisions.final: Changed. Posting runs from a local session in your Chrome. It checks it is signed in to the right TifoMaker account on each platform, then posts or schedules only approved posts. The full prompt for that session is in marketing/social/POSTING-SESSION.md.

decisions.rec: Listen with headphones and pick the one that sounds like a fan you'd trust in the stands, not a news reader. My lean is Jeddawi: young, from Jeddah, and the most used Saudi voice in the library. But your ear decides this one.
decisions.why: Every voice reads the same two lines, with harakat on every word, on ElevenLabs' newest model, so you are comparing voices, not scripts. The one you pick reads every video that needs a voice. If a word still sounds wrong, tell me which one.

options.label: Jeddawi
options.desc: Young, from Jeddah, calm and confident

decisions.script: تِيفُو نَادِيكْ، بِمَلْعَبَهْ الْحَقِيقِي، كُرْسِي كُرْسِي. نُمُورْ مَا تَهَابْ الْمَوْتْ! تِيفُو صَمَّمَهْ وَاحِدْ مِنْ جُمْهُورْ الْاِتِّحَادْ… وِشُوفُوهْ كَيْفْ يِرْتِفِعْ بِالْمُدَرَّجْ.
